description:
RETILIER is a premium fashion brand built around presence, aesthetics, and modern lifestyle.

Focused on timeless pieces, minimalist identity, and high quality products, Retilier creates apparel that naturally fits into fashion content, lifestyle content, and modern social selling.

Our goal is to build partnerships with creators and affiliates who know how to turn content, influence, and audience connection into real organic sales.

Why creators perform well with Retilier

Retilier products have strong visual appeal and perform naturally across:
• Lifestyle content
• Men’s and women’s fashion content
• Short form videos
• Organic content
• Social selling
• TikTok and Instagram Reels
• Conversion focused content

The brand was designed to integrate naturally into modern creator content, making it easier to both create content and generate sales.

Partnership opportunity

Retilier gives creators and affiliates the opportunity to monetize their audience through personalized referral links and exclusive creator codes.

• 20% commission on every successful sale
• Performance based increases up to 30%
• Personalized affiliate links and creator codes
• Full dashboard for performance tracking
• Sales, clicks, and commission tracking
• Monthly payouts
• Direct support from our team

Current customer offer

Buy 2 items and get 1 free.

An offer designed to increase conversions and make product promotion feel more natural through content.

Why this partnership works

• Premium products with strong conversion potential
• Fashion content performs naturally across social media
• Organic creator driven sales model
• Global scaling potential
• Simple structure to get started
• Real opportunity to turn content into recurring income

What we look for

We are looking for creators and partners who:
• Create authentic content
• Have strong connection with their audience
• Understand the power of organic content
• Want to monetize their audience
• Are interested in growing through performance
• Value consistency over virality

Support & resources

Creators inside the program receive access to:
• Personalized dashboard
• Sales and commission tracking
• Referral links and creator codes
• Campaign support
• Content guidance
• Direct communication with our team

How to get started

• Apply to the program
• Set up your account
• Access your dashboard
• Get your personal link and creator code
• Share in your own style
• Track your performance and scale over time

Retilier was built for creators who want to turn content and influence into a real source of income through organic sales.
payout_period:
Commissions are processed monthly.

Payments are typically sent between the 1st and 5th business day of each month after commission review and approval.

Please make sure your payment information is correctly configured to avoid delays.
